connector.name: ClearPost: WordPress SEO Agent
connector.registryDescription: SEO agent for WordPress. Grows your organic traffic on autopilot. 14 tools, zero configuration.
connector.summary: Hosted at {site_domain} over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.clearpostplugin, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.
